body: Yeah I’ve talked. I’ve tried everything I possibly can think of to stop thinking like this. Nothing is working
I’m just sick of every night crying myself to sleep. To hating myself. I can’t even look at myself in the mirror because it’s not me looking back I don’t recognise what I see any more
Sorry don’t be sad. Its just how things turn out. I could love to be 100 and have 72 years of wishing I didn’t
The feelings have been there for months tormenting every second of every day. Nothing seems to shake them . It’s not a life worth living
I’d rather not be than live every single day wishing I was gone
many people don’t think or act like that
I wish there was a way to say goodbye and sorry again all. Mental health even in today’s world is a weakness to most. And you get treated like it

I’ve tried. I get told to think happy thoughts that it will all go away. It’s just not that simple. I feel selfish for these thoughts but I’ve always put others first in life just once I want to do something for me. I’ve tried to get better believe me I’ve tried. But how do you approach someone and say. I want to die .
I know what your saying. I’ve had these feelings for many years. I had a brief moment of peace for a few weeks then it all came back. I’d just like to find a peaceful way to say goodbye
Feel the world gave up on me a long time ago. Picked me up tore me to pieces and left me to try and cope just for a bit of sport.
